Keyboard current: Tab cycles major panes; arrows move keyboard focus between canvas nodes; Enter activates selected node; Ctrl+Enter opens parameters.
Keyboard recommendation: Keep Tab/arrows/Enter behavior. Add visible focus ring and optional shortcut help overlay.
Mouse current: Click selects nodes; drag empty canvas selects multiple nodes; scrollbars pan canvas.
Mouse recommendation: Keep click/drag. Add mouse-wheel canvas pan conventions once viewer conventions are settled.
Keyboard + mouse current: Ctrl-click on a wire removes it; keyboard focus can combine with Enter/Ctrl+Enter.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Ctrl-click wire deletion. Consider Shift-click to add/remove node from selection.
Trackpad current: Native scrolling through canvas scroll views via OS/Flutter.
Trackpad recommendation: Support two-finger pan naturally; consider Ctrl+trackpad pinch or scroll for canvas zoom if canvas zoom is added.
Touchscreen recommendation: One-finger pan canvas; tap select; long-press context menu; two-finger pinch if canvas zoom is added.

Keyboard current: No dedicated keyboard shortcut in raw viewer.
Keyboard recommendation: Add Up/Down or PageUp/PageDown for channel/page scroll when viewer has focus.
Mouse current: Mouse wheel over trace scrolls vertically through channels.
Mouse recommendation: Keep wheel vertical channel scroll. Add stronger visual feedback showing channel range.
Keyboard + mouse current: No modifier needed for vertical scroll; modifiers repurpose wheel for zoom/scale/horizontal scroll.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep plain wheel as vertical scroll because it is predictable.
Trackpad current: Two-finger vertical scroll maps to pointer scroll and scrolls channels.
Trackpad recommendation: Keep. Tune scroll speed separately from mouse wheel if Flutter exposes useful signal characteristics.
Touchscreen recommendation: One-finger vertical drag scrolls channels; inertia should feel native.

Keyboard current: No dedicated keyboard shortcut in raw viewer.
Keyboard recommendation: Add Left/Right for small time shift; Shift+Left/Right for larger jumps; Home/End to start/end.
Mouse current: Horizontal scrollbar is available; some devices may send horizontal wheel delta.
Mouse recommendation: Keep scrollbar. Add grab-and-drag timeline or minimap scrubber.
Keyboard + mouse current: Shift+mouse wheel scrolls horizontally through time.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Shift+wheel horizontal scroll. Add tooltip/shortcut hint in scale cluster.
Trackpad current: Shift+two-finger scroll works if modifier is held; native horizontal two-finger scroll may work when dx is emitted.
Trackpad recommendation: Support native horizontal two-finger scroll without requiring Shift when dx dominates.
Touchscreen recommendation: One-finger horizontal drag pans time when gesture starts in trace area; two-finger pan can preserve channel/time distinction.

Keyboard recommendation: Add +/- for zoom around viewport center; Ctrl+Left/Right to shrink/expand time span; maybe number keys for presets.
Mouse current: Scale pill menu can select fixed time spans.
Mouse recommendation: Keep pill presets. Add direct text entry for exact span later.
Keyboard + mouse current: Ctrl+mouse wheel zooms time around pointer by changing window_sec.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Ctrl+wheel anchored zoom. Consider making zoom factor configurable or slightly gentler.
Trackpad current: Ctrl+two-finger scroll works as pointer-scroll zoom; true pinch not explicitly handled.
Trackpad recommendation: Support trackpad pinch for time zoom if available; otherwise keep Ctrl+scroll.
Touchscreen recommendation: Pinch horizontally to zoom time around gesture midpoint; double-tap axis to reset.

Keyboard recommendation: Add [ and ] or Alt+Up/Down for signal range steps; 0 resets to auto/default.
Mouse current: Scale pill menu can select fixed uV ranges; wheel over pill steps options.
Mouse recommendation: Keep pill menu. Add axis drag or scale-handle affordance later.
Keyboard + mouse current: Alt+mouse wheel steps amplitude scale through predefined y_scale_uv options.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Alt+wheel. Add on-screen hint near Scale controls.
Trackpad current: Alt+two-finger scroll works as pointer-scroll scale step.
Trackpad recommendation: Keep. Consider smoother continuous scaling for trackpads rather than discrete steps.
Touchscreen recommendation: Two-finger vertical pinch or drag on y-axis area adjusts signal range; double-tap y-axis resets.

Keyboard current: Spacing is automatic and derived from signal range and visible data; no keyboard control.
Keyboard recommendation: Keep automatic as default. Add optional manual override only if users need it later.
Mouse recommendation: Keep noninteractive auto label for now; eventually allow toggle between Auto and Manual.
Keyboard + mouse current: No modifier; indirectly changes when y scale changes.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep indirect coupling: channel spacing should follow amplitude to use vertical space well.
Trackpad current: Follows y scale and current data behavior.
Trackpad recommendation: Keep automatic. Ensure it updates without layout jank during smooth trackpad gestures.
Touchscreen recommendation: Keep automatic. If manual override arrives, expose as simple pinch/slider in a touch-friendly sheet.

Keyboard recommendation: Add shortcut to focus marker list; Enter on marker jumps; second Enter centers selected marker.
Mouse current: Click marker instances in right panel jumps to them; second click centers if already visible.
Mouse recommendation: Keep second-click center behavior. Add minimap marker navigation later.
Keyboard + mouse current: Mouse plus keyboard not required; Alt-drag creates alternate artifact labels in artifact detection.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Alt-drag for label menu; consider keyboard-accessible equivalent.
Trackpad current: Trackpad click behaves like mouse click.
Trackpad recommendation: Keep. Ensure two-finger scroll in marker panel scrolls panel, not trace.
Touchscreen recommendation: Tap marker row to jump; second tap centers; long press opens marker actions.

Function: Segment viewer vertical scroll across marker panels
Keyboard recommendation: Add Up/Down and PageUp/PageDown to scroll all marker panels together.
Mouse current: Mouse wheel scrolls segment content; marker panels are linked so one panel scrolls all together.
Mouse recommendation: Keep linked vertical scroll. Add visible 'linked scroll' affordance if it becomes confusing.
Keyboard + mouse current: No modifier needed for vertical segment scroll.
Trackpad current: Two-finger vertical scroll should use linked scroll controllers.
Trackpad recommendation: Keep and tune for speed; preserve linked behavior.
Touchscreen recommendation: One-finger vertical drag scrolls all marker panels together.

Function: Segment viewer horizontal scroll within plots
Keyboard recommendation: Add Left/Right for time pan within segment plots; Shift+Left/Right for larger step.
Mouse current: Horizontal scrollbar appears when time zoom exceeds panel width.
Mouse recommendation: Keep scrollbar. Add drag-to-pan inside plot background.
Keyboard + mouse current: Shift+mouse wheel scrolls horizontally inside segment plot tiles.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Shift+wheel horizontal scroll; make behavior match raw viewer exactly.
Trackpad current: Shift+two-finger scroll works; native horizontal delta may not be fully honored.
Trackpad recommendation: Support native horizontal two-finger scroll when dx dominates.
Touchscreen recommendation: One-finger horizontal drag pans time within segment plots; two-finger pan can disambiguate from page scroll.

Function: Segment viewer x zoom / time zoom
Keyboard recommendation: Add +/- for time zoom when segment viewer has focus; 0 reset.
Mouse current: No direct mouse-only zoom control visible beyond current UI controls.
Mouse recommendation: Add compact zoom pill or axis gesture if users need discoverability.
Keyboard + mouse current: Ctrl+mouse wheel changes segmented_time_zoom from 1x to 8x.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Ctrl+wheel. Anchor zoom to pointer if practical, not just scale width.
Trackpad current: Ctrl+two-finger scroll works as pointer-scroll zoom.
Trackpad recommendation: Support trackpad pinch for time zoom if available.
Touchscreen recommendation: Horizontal pinch zooms segment time axis; double-tap resets.

Function: Segment viewer y zoom / amplitude zoom
Keyboard recommendation: Add Alt+Up/Down or [/] for y zoom; 0 reset with time zoom.
Mouse current: No direct mouse-only y zoom control visible beyond current UI controls.
Mouse recommendation: Expose y zoom in same compact scale cluster used by raw viewer.
Keyboard + mouse current: Alt+mouse wheel changes segmented_y_zoom from 0.25x to 6x.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep Alt+wheel. Match raw viewer terminology: Range or Amplitude.
Trackpad current: Alt+two-finger scroll works as pointer-scroll y zoom.
Trackpad recommendation: Consider continuous y zoom for trackpad.
Touchscreen recommendation: Vertical pinch or y-axis drag adjusts amplitude; double-tap y-axis resets.

Keyboard recommendation: Add Left/Right pan and +/- zoom only if PSD becomes pannable/zoomable.
Mouse current: Current PSD controls include range/log options and automatic canonical band shading; no custom pan/zoom gestures.
Mouse recommendation: Keep simple by default. Add frequency-range presets and optional brush zoom later.
Keyboard + mouse current: No specific keyboard+mouse PSD zoom implementation.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Use Ctrl+wheel over chart for frequency zoom if PSD interaction becomes important.
Trackpad current: No specific trackpad PSD zoom implementation.
Trackpad recommendation: Support pinch/scroll zoom only after chart virtualization/performance is solid.
Touchscreen recommendation: Pinch zoom frequency axis and drag pan if PSD chart becomes interactive.

Keyboard recommendation: Add shortcuts only after y-scale controls are standardized across viewers.
Mouse current: PSD has y-axis range mode controls including auto/fixed and log scaling option.
Mouse recommendation: Keep controls. Align naming with raw viewer scale cluster where possible.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Alt+wheel over PSD could adjust y range if we standardize across chart types.
Trackpad recommendation: Same as mouse once standard chart gesture layer exists.
Touchscreen recommendation: Y-axis drag/pinch could adjust range; double-tap reset.

Keyboard current: No keyboard-specific implementation in scale pill menus.
Keyboard recommendation: Make pills focusable; Enter opens menu; arrows change option; Escape closes.
Mouse current: Click opens popup menu; wheel over pill steps through options.
Mouse recommendation: Keep. Add tiny hover hint explaining wheel support.
Keyboard + mouse current: Mouse wheel over focused/hovered pill steps options; modifiers not required inside pill.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Keep because it is fast and pleasantly discoverable after first use.
Trackpad current: Two-finger scroll over pill steps options.
Trackpad recommendation: Keep if not too twitchy; maybe require hover/focus dwell before stepping.
Touchscreen recommendation: Tap opens bottom sheet or popup with large touch targets; swipe within sheet changes values.

Keyboard recommendation: Add 0 to reset current viewer scales; Shift+0 reset all viewer scales and scroll offsets.
Mouse current: No explicit reset gesture beyond choosing preset values manually.
Mouse recommendation: Add double-click axis/scale pill to reset; add visible reset button if users get lost.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Ctrl+double-click or double-click scale pill resets that dimension.
Trackpad recommendation: Two-finger double-tap or double-click equivalent where supported; otherwise reset button.
Touchscreen recommendation: Double-tap axis or reset button in scale sheet.

Keyboard recommendation: Use unmodified keys for fine; Shift for coarse; Alt for alternate axis where needed.
Mouse current: Mouse wheel uses default deltas; discrete y-scale options for amplitude.
Mouse recommendation: Keep discrete stepping for amplitude, but allow continuous zoom for time.
Keyboard + mouse current: Ctrl/Alt/Shift modifiers choose axis but not granularity.
Keyboard + mouse recommendation: Use Shift as coarse only where it does not already mean horizontal scroll; otherwise use Ctrl+Shift for coarse zoom.
Trackpad current: Trackpad gestures may feel too sensitive because deltas are reused directly.
Touchscreen recommendation: Use gesture velocity and pinch distance; provide snapping only at rest.

Touchscreen current: No explicit touch handling in raw or segment viewers.
Touchscreen recommendation: Define global viewer grammar: one-finger pan, pinch zoom active axis, two-finger pan, double-tap reset, long-press context/actions.
